artist.name: D80
artist.bio: D80 is the DJ and live act of Anubhav Sharma, who grew up in Delhi, spent time in Los Angeles and returned to Delhi to play disco. His DJ sets cover disco from different eras and places, his live sets use synthesisers and analogue gear, and he hosts the show Across The Universe on boxout.fm.

eras.sound: Disco across eras, plus live synth and analogue sets
